text:
Karina (AE): quick heads-up — EU fintech prospect wants a 3-month pilot. asking for lower per-token for hosted embeddings + gen. expects ~500M tokens/mo for month 1, ramp to 800M by month 3. can we do an override for EU region?
Dan (AM): who’s the contact & legal constraints? data residency / pii?
Karina (AE): contact is Lise at ClearLedger. They need EU-only hosting (we have region), and they asked for SOC2 + standard DPA. No special encryption asks.
Raj (RevOps): numbers? what price are they proposing vs standard?
Karina (AE): they proposed $0.0006/token for gen + $0.0001 for embeddings. our hosted list is $0.0012 gen / $0.00025 embed. They want the lower rates just for the 3-month pilot, volume committed is soft.
Raj (RevOps): hm. that’s ~50% off on gen and ~60% off on embeddings. For soft commit pilots we usually allow promo credits or a small tier discount, not permanent per-token overrides. Can we structure as: 3-month pilot at 50% list but with a $10k min monthly commitment + auto-revert to list after pilot?
Sophie (Eng): capacity-wise EU region can handle 800M tokens/mo but need to pin model variants. which model?
Karina (AE): they want r-instruct-3.5-like for gen and r-embed-large for embeddings.
Sophie (Eng): r-embed-large quantized is fine. For gen, if they want low-latency we should recommend smaller context or a gpt-3.5 family variant. Also note continuous KV cache might increase cost; recommend batching.
Raj (RevOps): Karina — can you get a firm commit or at least a billing contact willing to sign a temporary addendum? We need an explicit billing person for discounted tiers.
Karina (AE): will get that today.
PricingBot: Suggested option A: 40% off gen / 55% off embed for 3 months with a $10k/mo minimum and requires billing PO + one-page pilot addendum. Option B: promo credit of $25k applied up front, revert to list pricing.
Dan (AM): which of those preserves revenue recognition / accounting easiest?
Raj (RevOps): Option A is cleaner — recognized as discounted revenue. Option B is just credit and messier for reporting but faster to approve.
Karina (AE): customer prefers lower per-token (Option A) if we can do it without long legal.
Raj (RevOps): I can pre-approve Option A for EU pilots up to 3 months if: (1) billing PO + contact, (2) $10k/mo min, (3) auto-revert clause, (4) pricing expiry date inserted. Need deal desk ticket with those fields.
Karina (AE): noted — I'll gather billing PO and contract contact.
Sophie (Eng): one operational note: if they ramp above 1B tokens/mo we need to schedule capacity reservations — ping eng-ops.
Karina (AE): thanks. Raj — can you open the deal desk ticket? I’ll attach the PO and contact when I have it.
Raj (RevOps): opening ticket now — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-PT-4591. Please add PO and pilot start/end dates.
Karina (AE): added preliminary estimates + Lise contact.
PricingBot: Reminder: include region = eu-west-1 in ticket and model pins to avoid cross-region fallbacks.
Dan (AM): awesome. labeling for exec review?
Raj (RevOps): not needed for $10k/mo. If they ask for >60% off or >$50k total concession, escalate.
Karina (AE): perfect. will loop legal if they push on residency language. :thumbsup:
Sophie (Eng): I'll stand by for capacity reservation if ticket notes ramp > 800M tokens/mo.
Karina (AE): thanks all — will update thread once PO is in.
